description: Search current published Belgium Art knowledge by place, topic or question. Lexical retrieval over titles, aliases, introductions, current author passages and available answers. Questions may come from published blocks or reviewed navigation metadata. Russian content with Russian/English place aliases. Results expose string arrays matched_terms and unmatched_terms; partial means incomplete lexical evidence, not an exact entity match. A city alone is insufficient. Never substitute another city.
name: search_knowledge
title: Найти место или тему
